text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah... haaah~~~...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Akebono...
I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Total defeat, desu! Sooo frustrating!
But, but but but but!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It was soooooo very much fun, YES!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Taiki-san...!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
S-Such presence...! That was amazing, Bono-chan!
How do I put it... wow, it was simply overwhelming!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text: I couldn't take my eyes off her! She was right there the whole time, and my heart just kept burning hotter and hotter...!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, thank you so much,
Bono-chan... Hishi Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff* I didn't win, but...
it was a great race! Thank you for giving me courage!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Amazing, incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The soup soaks in, the broth is bursting with flavor, everyone's smiling... and so am I...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm so full~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Taiki-san~!!
Thank you, everyone~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I had a whole lot of fun too~~!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Look, look, right here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where Hishi Akebono was pointing—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There were spectators ecstatic over the thrilling race, and Umamusume wiping away sweat as they caught their breath.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, I feel so warm and toasty!
Warm all over, and completely full!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I, I, I—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ngggh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, Hishi Akebono lightly vaulted over the grandstand fence and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Toryaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thrown high into the sky!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Spreading out below were the smiling faces of the audience, and the Umamusume looking satisfied despite their defeat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A midair flip—and with a soft thud,
I am caught and held in a massive embrace.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enveloped in Hishi Akebono's warmth and roaring cheers,
the Mile Championship drew to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the headline "Hishi Akebono's Trainer Flies Through the Air"
became a bit of a hot topic.
